keyFindings.description: Regression from dc06110d. sessionInfoFor treats every error other than ErrKeyNotFound and ErrMalformedInterest as a read that did not answer. A session id the session bucket holds but the interest bucket refuses as a key (bus.ErrRefused: a legacy key longer than envoy_interests' 3974-byte get limit, or one outside nats.go's alphabet) therefore makes sessionsHandler answer the whole GET /v1/sessions with writeBusUnavailable's 413 or 400. Before dc06110d that session was listed with no topics. GET /v1/registry/<id> also turns from 200 into 413 for such a session. The comment at api.go:665-667, 'Any other error is a read that did not answer ... the bus-unavailable 503', is false for this case. Fix: no interest record can exist under a refused key, so answer bus.ErrRefused in sessionInfoFor as ErrKeyNotFound is answered (empty topics and roles); correct the comment; add a list test with testnats.LegacyKeys(bus.SessionBucket, ...).
